title: Fast-forward a completed k-molecular collision family by an exact conserved-count identity
statement: Fix k>=2 and a rational d-state single-molecule generator A with positive off-diagonal a_ij and positive rational stationary vector c. At n=1 include EVERY channel e_i+beta->e_j+beta for i!=j, |beta|=k-1, with kappa=a_ij*multinomial(k-1,beta). Each fixed-beta translated subnetwork is balanced at c, hence their union is complex balanced and conserves N=sum x_i. Falling-factorial Vandermonde gives sum_beta multinomial(k-1,beta)*(x)_(e_i+beta)=x_i*(N-1)_(k-1), so the total conversion rate is exactly a_ij*x_i*alpha_N,V, alpha=(N-1)_(k-1)/V^(k-1). The FULL population generator equals N independent A-particles at common conserved-count clock alpha. For N<k return x0; otherwise finite-generator binary-time kernels exp(alpha*T*A) plus compressed DDB1 binomial/multinomial allocations give valid all-time endpoint samples with every-run polynomial complete-binary cost and unconditional entire-TV accuracy. This includes exponentially many effective interactions without event enumeration. On a spatial graph, local N_v fluctuates and creates a coupled random clock; this identity does not supply that sampler.
